note: Supplemental source inspection added after initial IMF pilot; no preselection or outcome-blind claim. Rolling 12m horizons differ across surveys. Prior survey dates are NOT the verified availability date: only later source publication date is known. No actual return join or alpha test.

sources.locator: U.S. stock returns; methodology; Fear and Doubt Index
sources.population: Approximately 2,000 randomly sampled personal and 401(k) investors; survey every other month since February 2017.

sources.locator: U.S. stock returns; Fear and Doubt Index
Policy accommodations; Economic outlook; Inflation; Capital markets outlook
sources.paraphrase: Expected less accommodative monetary policy, potentially more tightening than priced, roughly 4% US growth and slowing inflation in H2; long-term equity returns constrained by valuations.

sources.locator: Global outlook summary; higher rates and equities
sources.paraphrase: Expected persistent higher structural interest rates and lower long-term US equity returns. Acknowledged stronger 2023 growth than expected; 10y annualized US equity forecast range 4.2–6.2%, previously 4.4–6.4% heading into 2023. Long horizon, not a 2024 return target.

interpretation.observation: Expected rolling one-year return fell 6.0→2.7 between Dec 2021 and Dec 2022, rebounded to 5.7 in Dec 2023; survey sample is not necessarily same respondents.
interpretation.hypothesis: Expectations may follow realized market direction, not lead it. Test lagged price baseline and within-person revision on independent source-admitted panel; cannot infer investor behavior or mispricing from aggregate beliefs alone.
interpretation.noncomparability: Calendar-year S&P TR is not exact survey-response-to-12-month return; do not calculate forecast errors before matching survey field dates, benchmark, dividends and original release clocks. Vanguard analysts' 10-year range differs from survey 12-month forecasts; compare only same horizon and definitions (investors 7.2 vs analysts 4.2–6.2 in late 2023, descriptive; not identical forecast statistics).
